newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Farmer selling increases.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Farmer selling increases.

text.p: Farmer sales of dark northern spring wheat picked up substantially across the northern U.S grain belt, grain merchandisers said Wednesday.
"We finaly got the interest of the farmer," a Minneapolis dealer said.

"We bought quite a lot of wheat again today. I think guys are selling because they've got last-quarter taxes, Christmas is coming and they've got fertilizer bills to pay," a central Montana dealer said. "You normally see this around this time of year, and you'll probably see more (farmer sales) after the New Year because of tax purposes."
A dealer at one major merchandiser in Minnesota said his company had handled several million bushels' worth of hedge-related trades as a result of the increase in sales.
While farmers were selling, physical movement of wheat remained slow as a result of the severe winter weather in the upper Midwest. Only one car traded on the cash market in Minneapolis.
